turns.text: Hi everyone and welcome to my brand new series Everyday English. Today we'll
turns.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到我的全新系列「日常英语」。今天我们会

turns.text: learn Everyday English while making my favorite breakfast. Let's get started!
turns.zh: 一边做我最爱的早餐，一边学日常英语。咱们开始吧！

turns.text: This recipe you'll need...
turns.zh: 这个食谱你需要……

turns.text: Taus bread, ham, butter, milk, eggs, cheese, slices, salt and pepper. But before we start cooking let's get
turns.zh: 吐司面包、火腿、黄油、牛奶、鸡蛋、芝士片、盐和胡椒。不过开始做饭之前，咱们先把

turns.text: everything ready. We'll need a cutting board, a knife, spatulas, whisk, tongues and
turns.zh: 东西都准备好。我们需要一块砧板、一把刀、锅铲、打蛋器、夹子，还有

turns.text: of course frying pan. And First let's slice some ham.
turns.zh: 当然少不了一个煎锅。首先，咱们切点火腿片。

turns.text: Unwrap the cheese slices.
turns.zh: 把芝士片拆开。

turns.text: Then crack 3 eggs into a small bowl. Add some salt, pepper and milk.
turns.zh: 然后往小碗里打三个鸡蛋。加点盐、胡椒和牛奶。

turns.text: Now whisk until smooth. Now let's heat up the pan.
turns.zh: 现在搅打到顺滑。然后咱们把锅热上。

turns.text: Add some butter.
turns.zh: 加点黄油。

turns.text: Toast the bread on both seconds on each side.
turns.zh: 把面包两面各烤几秒钟。

turns.text: Time to start assembling the sandwich.
turns.zh: 该开始组装三明治了。

turns.text: Now let's cook these scrambled eggs we prepared earlier.
turns.zh: 现在咱们来炒刚才准备好的鸡蛋。

turns.text: Pour the mixture into the pan.
turns.zh: 把蛋液倒进锅里。

turns.text: Let it set a little. Then gently stir until soft and fluffy.
turns.zh: 让它稍微凝固一下。然后轻轻搅拌，直到变得柔软蓬松。

turns.text: Don't overcook the eggs. Keep them creamy, not dry.
turns.zh: 鸡蛋别炒过头了。要保持嫩滑，别炒干了。

turns.text: The eggs are ready. Let's add them on top of our sandwich like a soft fluffy crayon.
turns.zh: 鸡蛋好了。咱们把它们铺在三明治上，像软绵绵的蜡笔一样。

turns.text: fluffy crayon. If you like add some sauce. I mixed mayonnaise with sriracha. It's creamy with just a touch of heat. For a quick and healthy side I like
turns.zh: 软绵绵的蜡笔。喜欢的话可以加点酱。我把蛋黄酱和是拉差辣酱混在一起了。口感顺滑，还带一点点辣。想要快速又健康的配菜，我喜欢

turns.text: cucumber or carrot sticks with a pinch of salt on it. And that's it! A delicious ham,
turns.zh: 黄瓜条或者胡萝卜条，上面撒一小撮盐。这就搞定啦！一份美味的火腿

turns.text: eggs and cheese toast. Simple, quick and full of English words that you can use every day.
turns.zh: 鸡蛋芝士吐司。简单、快速，还满满都是你每天都能用上的英语单词。

turns.text: Mmm, so good. Crispy bread, creamy eggs, melted cheese. You have to try this.
turns.zh: 嗯，太好吃了。面包酥脆，鸡蛋嫩滑，芝士融化。你一定要试试。

turns.text: Thanks for watching Everyday English.
turns.zh: 感谢收看「日常英语」。

turns.text: Have a nice day and see you next time. Bye!
turns.zh: 祝你今天愉快，咱们下次见。拜拜！
